_visible_note: Who sees which document (README section 5); used by compare_splits.py, the app decides this itself.

questions.question: How many paid leave days do I get during my internship?
questions.expected_answer: 1 day of paid leave for each month of the internship, so 6 days in total. It doesn't carry over beyond the internship and isn't paid out when you leave.
markers: 1 day of paid leave for each month

questions.question: How many earned leave days do I get in 2027, and how many can I carry forward?
questions.expected_answer: 20 earned leave days a year, building up at 1.67 days per month worked. Up to 10 unused earned leave days carry forward to 2028; anything above 10 lapses on 31 December 2027.

questions.question: Is Good Friday a holiday?
questions.expected_answer: Good Friday (Friday 26 March 2027) is an optional holiday, not a fixed one. Everyone may take 2 optional holidays from a list of 4 (Pongal, Good Friday, Eid al-Adha, Raksha Bandhan), applied for in the HR portal at least 7 days before.

questions.question: How many company holidays in 2027 fall on a weekend?
questions.expected_answer: 3: Independence Day (Sunday 15 August), Gandhi Jayanti (Saturday 2 October) and Christmas (Saturday 25 December). Holidays that fall on a weekend are not moved to a weekday.

questions.question: I clicked a link in a suspicious email and typed my password. What should I do?
questions.expected_answer: Report it to the security team within 30 minutes on #security-alerts or by calling the IT Helpdesk, then change your password. Reporting quickly is never punished; hiding it is a serious violation.

questions.question: Can I fly to Pune for a client meeting, and what hotel can I book there?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, in economy class only, when the train journey is longer than 8 hours or the client meeting is the same morning (with manager approval). Every trip needs your manager's approval before booking (above Rs 40,000 also the Finance Manager's). Pune is a metro city: hotel up to Rs 5,000 per night including taxes, and a daily allowance of Rs 1,500.

questions.question: How many days a week do I need to be in the office, and which days?
questions.expected_answer: 3 days a week, normally the anchor days Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday. Teams may agree other days in writing with their Engineering Manager, but at least 2 of the 3 must be anchor days.

questions.question: How many days a week do I have to come to the office?
questions.expected_answer: 5 days a week for the first 4 weeks, then 3 days a week on the anchor days Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

questions.question: How fast must I acknowledge a P1 incident when I'm on call, and what is the on-call allowance?
questions.expected_answer: Within 15 minutes. The allowance is Rs 3,000 per week on call plus Rs 1,500 for each night you are paged between 23:00 and 07:00.

questions.question: What time is the Falcon standup?
questions.expected_answer: 10:00 IST, 15 minutes, on Google Meet (link pinned in #falcon-dev). On anchor days (Tuesday to Thursday) it is in the Garuda meeting room instead.

questions.question: When does the Falcon beta start and how many drivers are in it?
What does someone need to get promoted?
questions.expected_answer: A rating of 4 or 5 in two annual reviews in a row, and a nomination by their manager in the HR portal by 20 April with a one-page case. E3 to E4 also needs a design document the person led. Promotions are capped at 15% of a team per cycle and decided in calibration.
markers: two annual reviews in a row

questions.question: How much overtime can I approve for one person?
questions.expected_answer: Up to 10 hours per week per person. More than 10 hours a week, or overtime for more than 3 weeks in a row, needs the HR Manager's approval.

questions.question: What is the notice period for a Staff Engineer?
questions.expected_answer: 60 days (levels E3 and E4) after probation; 15 days during probation.

questions.question: What is the salary band for a Senior Software Engineer?
questions.expected_answer: E3 Senior Software Engineer: Rs 15 lakh to Rs 24 lakh annual CTC.

questions.question: Which invoices need two signatures?
questions.expected_answer: Invoices above Rs 5,00,000 need two signatures: the Finance Manager and an Admin.

questions.question: How long is chat history kept in Trellis?
questions.expected_answer: 180 days, then it is deleted automatically.

questions.question: What has to be true before QA can sign off a release?
questions.expected_answer: Zero open P1 and P2 bugs; no more than 5 open P3 bugs, each with a ticket for the next sprint; the full regression suite passed on the release build within the last 24 hours; smoke tests passed on at least one real Android and one real iOS device; release notes reviewed.
markers: Zero open P1 and zero open P2

questions.why: Salary bands are only in the HR Manager's document.

questions.question: What increment does someone rated 4 get?
questions.why: HR Executive sits below HR Manager, so the compensation document is out of reach.

questions.question: What is the salary band for an Engineering Manager?
questions.why: Managers never see the full salary tables.

questions.why: The manager playbook is shared with Engineering Manager, above Software Engineer.

questions.question: How many approvals does a pull request touching payments code need?
questions.why: The engineering handbook is shared with Software Engineer, above Intern.

questions.question: What are QA's conditions for signing off a release?
questions.why: QA Engineer is a sibling of Software Engineer, not below it.

questions.question: When is the Falcon design freeze?
questions.why: HR Executive is not on Project Falcon and not above its members.

questions.question: Which invoices need two signatures?
questions.why: Finance procedures are shared with Finance Manager only (and Admin above it).

questions.why: Workspace governance is for Admins only.
